overview_description.description: Boardcave is building the world’s largest online surf gear store as a one stop destination for surfers and all round ocean enthusiasts. The company has built their end to end marketplace software to reimagine how surfers progress and partake in ocean activities. Boardcave is backed by leading investors like YCombinator, GoodWater and Graeme Wood.

about_short_description.short_description: Boardcave is an online surf marketplace that provides online surf knowledge, gear and and instructional videos.

product.name: Surfboards
product.description: A range of surfboards including soft tops, shortboards, longboards, and specialty boards designed for various wave conditions and skill levels.

product.name: Surfboard Fins
product.description: Various types of surfboard fins including single, twin, thruster, quad, and five-fin setups from multiple brands.

product.name: Surf Accessories
product.description: A variety of surfing accessories including leashes, traction pads, wax, surfboard bags, racks, repair kits, and surf tools.

product.name: Wetsuits and Clothing
product.description: Wetsuits and surf-related clothing such as tees, hats, boardshorts, backpacks, and towels.

product.name: Instructional Surf Knowledge and Videos
product.description: Online surf knowledge and instructional videos to educate surfers on techniques, equipment, and surfboard selection.
